sentences.en: JIM: Hello, South City Cycling Club
sentences.zh: JIM: 你好，南城自行车俱乐部。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, hi
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，你好。

sentences.en: Er want to find out about joining the club
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯，我想了解一下加入俱乐部的相关事宜。

sentences.en: JIM: Right
sentences.zh: JIM: 好的。

sentences.en: I can help you there
sentences.zh: JIM: 我可以帮您解答。

sentences.en: I'm the club secretary and my name's Jim Hunter
sentences.zh: JIM: 我是俱乐部秘书，我叫吉姆·亨特。

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, hi Jim
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，你好，吉姆。

sentences.en: JIM: So, are you interested in membership for yourself?
sentences.zh: JIM: 那么，您是想为自己申请会员资格吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: That's right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 没错。

sentences.en: JIM: OK
sentences.zh: JIM: 好的。

sentences.en: Well there are basically two types of adult membership
sentences.zh: JIM: 目前成人会员基本分为两种类型。

sentences.en: If you're pretty serious about cycling, there's the Full membership
sentences.zh: JIM: 如果您对骑行非常认真，可以选择“正式会员”资格。

sentences.en: That costs 260 dollars and that covers you not just for ordinary cycling but also for races both here in the city and also in other parts of Australia
sentences.zh: JIM: 该资格费用为260美元，不仅涵盖日常骑行，还包括本市及澳大利亚其他地区的各类比赛。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了。

sentences.en: Well, I'm not really up to that standard
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我其实还没达到那种水平。

sentences.en: I was more interested in just joining ?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我更倾向于只是加入一个……

sentences.en: group to do some cycling in my free time
sentences.zh: WOMAN: ……在空闲时间一起骑行的团体。

sentences.en: JIM: Sure
sentences.zh: JIM: 当然可以。

sentences.en: That's why most people join
sentences.zh: JIM: 这也正是大多数人加入的原因。

sentences.en: So, in that case you'd be better with the Recreational membership
sentences.zh: JIM: 因此，您更适合选择“休闲会员”资格。

sentences.en: That's 108 dollars if you're over 19, and 95 dollars if you're under
sentences.zh: JIM: 如果您年满19周岁，费用为108美元；未满19周岁则为95美元。

sentences.en: WOMAN: I'm 25
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我今年25岁。

sentences.en: JIM: OK
sentences.zh: JIM: 好的。

sentences.en: It's paid quarterly, and you can upgrade it later to the Full membership if you want to, of course
sentences.zh: JIM: 会费按季度缴纳，当然，日后如需升级为正式会员，也可以随时办理。

sentences.en: Now both types of membership include the club fee of 20 dollars
sentences.zh: JIM: 另外，这两种会员资格均包含20美元的俱乐部会费。

sentences.en: They also provide insurance in case you have an accident, though we hope you won't need that, of course
sentences.zh: JIM: 此外，会员还享有意外事故保险（当然，我们衷心希望您永远用不上这项保障）。

sentences.en: WOMAN: No
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 不会的。

sentences.en: OK, well, I'll go with the Recreational membership, I think
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，我想我就选择休闲会员资格吧。

sentences.en: And that allows me to join in the club activities, and so on?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 这样我就可以参加俱乐部的各项活动，等等，对吗？

sentences.en: JIM: That's right
sentences.zh: JIM: 没错。

sentences.en: And once you're a member of the club, you're also permitted to wear our kit when you're out cycling
sentences.zh: JIM: 而且一旦成为俱乐部会员，您外出骑行时还可以穿着我们的队服。

sentences.en: It's green and white
sentences.zh: JIM: 队服是绿色和白色的。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, I've seen cyclists wearing it
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，我见过骑手们穿着它。

sentences.en: So, can I buy that at the club?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么，我可以在俱乐部直接购买队服吗？

sentences.en: JIM: No, it's made to order by a company in Brisbane
sentences.zh: JIM: 不行，队服由布里斯班的一家公司定制生产。

sentences.en: You can find them online: they're called Jerriz
sentences.zh: JIM: 您可以上网查找这家公司，名叫“杰里兹”（Jerriz）。

sentences.en: That's J-E-R-R-I-Z
sentences.zh: JIM: 拼写是 J-E-R-R-I-Z。

sentences.en: You can use your membership number tO put in an order on their website
sentences.zh: JIM: 您可使用自己的会员编号，在其网站上下单订购。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Now, can you tell me a bit about the rides I can do?
sentences.zh: 那么，您能给我介绍一下我可以参加的骑行活动吗？

sentences.en: JIM: Sure
sentences.zh: JIM: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So we have training rides pretty well every morning, and they're a really good way of improving your cycling skills as well as your general level of fitness, but they're different levels
sentences.zh: 我们几乎每天早上都有训练骑行活动，这不仅能提升您的骑行技能，还能增强整体健康水平，但这些活动分为不同难度等级。

sentences.en: Level A is pretty fast - you're looking at about 30 or 35 kilometres an hour
sentences.zh: A级速度较快——时速大约为30至35公里。

sentences.en: If you can do about 25 kilometres an hour, you'd probably be 04 level B. and then level C are the novices, who stay at about 15 kilometres per hour
sentences.zh: 如果您能以约25公里/小时的速度骑行，那您很可能属于B级；而C级则是初学者级别，时速维持在约15公里/小时。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了。

sentences.en: Well I reckon I'd be level B
sentences.zh: 我觉得我应该属于B级。

sentences.en: So, when are the sessions for that level?
sentences.zh: 那么，B级的训练课程安排在什么时候呢？

sentences.en: JIM: There are a couple each week
sentences.zh: JIM: 每周有两场。

sentences.en: They're both early morning sessions
sentences.zh: 这两场都在清晨举行。

sentences.en: There's one on Tuesdays, and for that one you meet at 5.30 am, and the meeting point's the stadium - do you know where that is?
sentences.zh: 其中一场在周二，集合时间为凌晨5:30，集合地点是体育场——您知道它在哪儿吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, it's quite near my home, in fact
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 知道，事实上离我家很近。

sentences.en: OK, and how about the other one?
sentences.zh: 好的，另一场呢？

sentences.en: JIM: That's on Thursdays
sentences.zh: JIM: 另一场在周四。

sentences.en: It starts at the same time, but they meet at the main gate to the park
sentences.zh: 开始时间相同，但集合地点是公园正门。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Is that the one just past the shopping mall?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是那个紧挨着购物中心的正门吗？

sentences.en: JIM: That's it
sentences.zh: JIM: 没错。

sentences.en: WOMAN: So how long are the rides?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么每次骑行持续多长时间？

sentences.en: JIM: They're about an hour a and a half
sentences.zh: JIM: 大约一个半小时。

sentences.en: So, if you have a job it's easy to fit in before you go to work
sentences.zh: 所以，如果您有工作，完全可以安排在上班前参加。

sentences.en: And the members often go somewhere for coffee afterwards, so it's quite a social event
sentences.zh: 而且成员们经常骑行结束后一起去喝咖啡，因此这也是一次不错的社交活动。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: That sounds good
sentences.zh: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: I've only just moved to the city So don't actually know many people yet
sentences.zh: 我刚搬到这座城市，实际上还没认识多少人。

sentences.en: JIM: Well, it's a great way to meet people
sentences.zh: JIM: 哦，这确实是结识新朋友的好方式。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And does each ride have a leader?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 每次骑行都有领骑员吗？

sentences.en: JIM: Sometimes, but not always
sentences.zh: JIM: 有时有，但并非每次都配备。

sentences.en: But you don't really need one; the group members on the ride support one another, anyway
sentences.zh: 不过其实并不一定需要领骑员；骑行过程中，团队成员彼此照应和支持。

sentences.en: WOMAN: How would we know where to go?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那我们怎么知道该往哪儿骑呢？

sentences.en: JIM: If you check the club website, you'll see that the route for each ride is clearly marked
sentences.zh: JIM: 您只要查看俱乐部网站，就会发现每场骑行的路线都标注得非常清晰。

sentences.en: So you can just print that out and take it along with you
sentences.zh: 您可以直接打印出来随身携带。

sentences.en: It's similar from one week to another, but it's not always exactly the same
sentences.zh: 路线每周大致相似，但并非完全一样。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And what do I need to bring?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我需要带些什么东西？

sentences.en: JIM: Well. bring a bottle of water, and your phone
sentences.zh: JIM: 嗯，带一瓶水和手机。

sentences.en: You shouldn't use it while you're cycling, but have it with you
sentences.zh: 骑行时请勿使用手机，但需随身携带。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了。

sentences.en: JIM: And in winter, it's well before sunrise when we set out, so you need to make sure your bike's got lights
sentences.zh: JIM: 冬季出发时间远早于日出，因此您务必确保自行车装有车灯。

sentences.en: WOMAN: That's OK
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 没问题。

sentences.en: Well, thanks Jim
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢谢您，Jim。

sentences.en: I'd definitely like to join
sentences.zh: 我肯定想加入。

sentences.en: So what's the best way of going about it?
sentences.zh: 那么，最好的做法是什么？

sentences.en: JIM: You can
sentences.zh: JIM: 你可以
